text:
julian: Heads-up — planning v2 rollout for public text/generation endpoints tomorrow 2026-03-21 09:00 UTC. Plan: staggered canary (1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%) over ~3 hours, with holds at each stage. Need explicit client pin and rollback criteria before we hit 5%. Any blockers?

deploy-bot: preflight checks OK: images built (sha: a1b2c3), infra green in eu/us, canary routing ready. Checklist: [infra, schema-migration-check, telemetry tag, alerting hooks]. Will require explicit /deploy command to start.

sasha: Client-eng: we require enforced header fallback for older SDKs. Rule proposal: if `X-Client-Version` header < `4.2.0` or missing, server should route to v1. Also accept `X-Compat-Prefer: v1` override. I'll push a small client-side guard later today.

owen: Runtime: we have automatic fallback to v1 for 5xxs but want a stricter canary SLO here: pause if error-rate delta > 2% (relative) for 10m OR if p95 latency increases by >200ms vs baseline. Also watch KV cache hit-rate — some models show cache churn with v2 quant configs.

maria: Product: publish short release notes outlining behavioral diffs (minor tokenization changes, tool-calling schema tweak). Also call out migration steps for integrators and exact SDK minimum. I'll draft and share the notes here by EOD.

ops-bot: Alerting config suggestions saved: 
- alert: v2_rollout_error_delta
  expr: rate(errors[10m]) - baseline_errors > 0.02
- alert: v2_latency_regress
  expr: p95_latency_v2 - p95_latency_v1 > 0.2s
Will create PagerDuty routing: oncall-eng for criticals.

julian: Summarize pin/stop criteria to confirm: 
1) Client pin: `X-Client-Version` < 4.2.0 -> route to v1.
2) Auto-pause: error-rate delta > 2% (10m) OR p95+200ms.
3) Manual stop: any data-loss/signature-break reported by integrations.
4) Metric hold windows at each stage: hold 20–30m at 5% and 25% to inspect telemetry.

Any additions? :thumbsup:

sasha: +1. Also suggest we instrument a lightweight compatibility probe — send a small `compat-check` request from the SDK after startup and log `X-Compat-Ok: true|false`. We'll include in the SDK patch.

owen: Add: if KV-cache miss-rate > 15% increase we should reduce batch size for v2 canaries (hotfix knob). I'll pre-bake a flag `runtime.batch_scale=0.5` for quick toggle.

maria: For release notes: include exact header examples and sample curl with fallback. Draft: 
```
# fallback example
curl -H "X-Client-Version: 4.1.8" https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate
# server will route to v1 and return header X-Served-From: v1
```
I'll attach that to the docs PR.

julian: OK locking the rollout cadence: 1% -> 5% (hold 25m) -> 25% (hold 30m) -> 100%. Telemetry tag: `v2-rollout-2791234567` required on all requests. Oncall: @sasha, @owen, @maria please be available for the first 90 minutes after start.

deploy-bot: Deployment plan saved. To execute at scheduled time run: 
```
/deploy start --release v2 --tag v2-rollout-2791234567 --strategy staggered --stages 1,5,25,100 --hold-mins 0,25,30,0
```
Prechecks: schema-migration: OK, canary-traffic-router: ready, telemetry: enabled.

sasha: I'll push the SDK guard and probe today, will ping when published.

owen: I'll preseed `runtime.batch_scale` flag and monitor cache metrics.

maria: I'll post release notes + quick migration checklist to #docs by 17:00 PT.

julian: Great — final ask: if anyone sees any client pins or major SDK versions stuck in the wild, drop them here. If not, I'll trigger `/deploy` tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled for 2026-03-21T09:00:00Z by julian. Will post live status updates in this thread.

julian: Thanks — locking it in. :lock:
